d: D means denoting a quantity consisting of 500 items or units.
D can also mean a fat-soluble vitamin that prevents rickets.
D can also mean the cardinal number that is the product of one hundred and five.
D means the same as five hundred or 500 or vitamin D.
d'holbach: D'Holbach is French philosopher famous as being one of the first self-described atheists in Europe.
D'Holbach means the same as Dietrich or Paul Heinrich Dietrich or Thiry.
d'oyly carte: D'Oyly Carte is English impresario who brought Gilbert and Sullivan together and produced many of their operettas in London.
D'Oyly Carte means the same as Richard D'Oyly Carte.
d-day: D-day is date of the Allied landing in France, World War II.
D-day means the same as 6 June 1944.
d-layer: D-layer is the lowest region of the ionosphere that reflects low-frequency radio waves.
D-layer means the same as D region.
d. h. lawrence: D. H. Lawrence is English novelist and poet and essayist whose work condemned industrial society and explored sexual relationships.
D. H. Lawrence means the same as Lawrence or David Herbert Lawrence.
d. w. griffith: D. W. Griffith is United States film maker who was the first to use flashbacks and fade-outs.
D. W. Griffith means the same as Griffith or David Lewelyn Wark Griffith.
D.A. is a doctor's degree with a special disciplinary focus.
D.A. means the same as Doctor of Arts.
D.C. is the district occupied entirely by the city of Washington.
D.C. means the same as District of Columbia or DC.
A d.j. is a person who announces and plays popular recorded music.
D.j. means the same as disk jockey or disc jockey or DJ.
D.P.R.K. is a communist country in the northern half of the Korean Peninsula.
D.P.R.K. means the same as North Korea or Democratic People's Republic of Korea or DPRK.
d and c: D and C is a surgical procedure usually performed under local anesthesia in which the cervix is dilated and the endometrial lining of the uterus is scraped with a curet.
D and C means the same as dilation and curettage or dilatation and curettage.
d region: D region is the lowest region of the ionosphere that reflects low-frequency radio waves.
D region means the same as D-layer.
D.o.a. means abbreviation for `dead on arrival' at the emergency room.
